title: Agents Vault — configuration to explicit access
audio: silent; English captions are burned into the video and supplied as WebVTT

segments.text: Agents Vault keeps project configuration readable and credential access explicit.
av.toml holds public values or references. Placeholder output does not resolve credentials.
New credentials have no release grants. Direct delivery gives a trusted command the real value.
For a synthetic proxy action, review the frozen command, destination, credential version, runtime and quotas.
After approval, the original waiting CLI runs. A temporary proxy capability lets the broker inject upstream.
Keep proxy credentials synthetic. Protected production custody remains a release gate; host commands are not confined.
